message.lumen.not_yours: This light is bound to someone else.
message.lumen.awakening: Something inside the vessel is waking up...
message.lumen.vessel_gift: You feel a faint warmth in your pack. Place the Lumen Vessel and open it.
command.lumen.help: Talk to your Lumen by starting a chat message with "%s" (e.g. "%1$s, where are diamonds?") or /lumen say <message>. Other commands: /lumen call | stay | follow | status | name <name> | forget | release. Give it glowing things to earn its trust. Hurt it and it will remember.
command.lumen.no_lumen: You have no Lumen. Place and open a Lumen Vessel first.
command.lumen.too_far: Your Lumen is too far away to hear you. Use /lumen call.
command.lumen.forget: Your Lumen has forgotten your recent conversation.
message.lumen.voice_needs_ai: Talking to Lumen with your voice needs speech recognition, which uses the AI key in config/lumen.json. You can still type: "lumen, ..."
message.lumen.voice_busy: Lumen is still listening to your last sentence...
message.lumen.voice_unheard: Lumen couldn't make out what you said.
